title: Donald Trump meets Imelda Marcos: We love you
summary: US President Donald Trump and former First Lady Imelda Marcos exchanged pleasantries on the sidelines of the American leader's bilateral meeting with her son, President Ferdinand "Bongbong" Marcos…

blocks.text: US President Donald Trump and former First Lady Imelda Marcos exchanged pleasantries on the sidelines of the American leader's bilateral meeting with her son, President Ferdinand "Bongbong" Marcos Jr., on Wednesday.
Trump arrived in the Philippines on Tuesday night for the 49th ASEAN Summit, where he met with several world leaders. The following day, Bongbong Marcos received Trump on the presidential grounds.
In a video posted on X by US Special Assistant to the President and Communications Advisor Margo Martin, Trump could be seen speaking to the Marcos matriarch.
“We love you!” Trump said in the short clip. Imelda was seen blowing kisses in return.
Trump and Imelda Marcos are friends from way back.
In 2024, Bongbong Marcos called Trump when he won the US presidential election to congratulate him, with the latter asking how his friend Imelda Marcos was doing.
Bongbong Marcos is the son and namesake of former President Ferdinand Marcos, Sr.
The US President’s ties to the Marcoses were further revisited during a dinner among ASEAN leaders ib Tuesday. Trump told Bongbong Marcos that he knew his parents very well.

“I just don’t want to date myself, but I knew your parents very well, and they were great. I believe in genetics, and they did a good job; you have very good genetics,” Trump said on Tuesday night. –NB, GMA News
